name: interp1_v5cubic
expr: a = interp1(x, y, 2.3, 'v5cubic'); b = interp1(x, y, 4.7, 'v5cubic'); c = interp1(x, y, 2.3, 'cubic'); d = interp1(0:5, y2, 2.4, 'v5cubic'); e = interp1(x, y, 2, 'v5cubic'); nu = interp1([0 1 2 4 5 6], y, 2.3, 'v5cubic'); sp = interp1([0 1 2 4 5 6], y, 2.3, 'spline');
comment: interp1 'v5cubic' / 'cubic' (2026-05-30). MATLAB's classic Keys cubic convolution (a=-0.5) on a uniformly-spaced grid; 'cubic' and 'v5cubic' are the SAME method (both = convolution, distinct from pchip/spline). numkit previously errored 'unknown method' for both. Uniform x^3 grid: a=interp1(2.3)=12.251, b=interp1(4.7)=104.18, c='cubic'=12.251 (==v5cubic), node-exact e=interp1(2)=8. Non-polynomial data d=interp1([2 1 4 1 5 9],2.4)=2.896. Non-uniform grid falls back to spline: nu==sp (9.4411250000). Out-of-range returns NaN (NOT a method-extrapolator, unlike spline/pchip/makima) -- not fingerprinted (NaN). Implemented via 1-D one-cell-padded Keys convolution (3*v1-3*v2+v3 border), reusing the kernel interp2 'cubic' uses. namespace=builtin. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
